title: Running-hit player returns to idle at native knockback landing

verification.actor: One full-current Wild Weepinbell70 and the current unmounted player.
verification.trigger: Normal UP+B admits at least one real stock Run before a native airborne Ambush hit. Release all keys at the first measured hit and native Jump1 start.
verification.observable: One real20HP hit starts native foot knockback; at the first completed centered terminal cmd255/step0 frame, native animationA0 and the same current renderer selector are both0. The next16 completed neutral frames stay settled and idle.

setupMutations.change: Copy unchanged test.nds and test.sav into a disposable session, teleport the player to map 33 (585,407), spawn one Wild Weepinbell at (585,404), and bind its current native identity. Do not force the Ambush, motion, HP, or RNG.

limits: Prepared teleport/spawn establishes the fixture; movement, hit, knockback and return use normal play with current timers.
The retained BEFORE shows one stale completed terminal frame, not a proved longer delay.
The UP+B approach can enter a stock blocked-run response before the hit; an earlier authenticated Run admission remains required.
Current Foot renderer words are read from the current player; no screenshots or new renderer owner.

events.value: Bind native Weepinbell70 and initial current player HP100.
Use UP+B until real Run admission then airborne Ambush hit/Jump1.
Release keys through native terminal and16 completed neutral idle frames.

stop.condition: Current native Run admission, real20HP Ambush hit, immediate idle at native knockback terminal and16 neutral completed frames; else the first missing identity/profile/HP/motion/animation/clock proof.

invariants: Full current Weepinbell resolves active Ambush1/16/20+Jump1
